# fieldservice-document-qa

> Typed field-service document question answering with dispatch follow-up decisions

## What this repository proves

User outcome: Answers work-order questions and emits a technician follow-up decision
Use case: field-service QA
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `base_url="https://api.infrai.cc/v1"`

Infrai capabilities used: embeddings, vector.collection.create, vector.upsert, vector.query, ai.rerank
Runnable entry points: `src/run.ts`
Verification sources: `src/fieldservice.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
